points.point: Draghi pledged the ECB would do "whatever it takes" to preserve the euro
points.quote: Within our mandate, the ECB is ready to do whatever it takes to preserve the euro.
paraphrases: Draghi pledged the ECB would do 'whatever it takes' to preserve the euro.
The ECB is ready to do whatever it takes to save the single currency, Draghi said.
Draghi vowed the ECB is ready to do 'whatever it takes' within its mandate to save the euro.
decoys: Draghi said the ECB would do everything possible, within reason, to support growth.
Trichet said the ECB stood ready to act decisively to defend the euro.

points.point: Draghi added "believe me, it will be enough", underscoring the ECB's resolve
points.quote: And believe me, it will be enough.
paraphrases: Draghi added, 'And believe me, it will be enough,' underscoring ECB resolve.
He stressed that the ECB's commitment would be enough, saying 'believe me.'
Draghi capped the pledge with 'believe me, it will be enough.'
decoys: Draghi said the measures might not be enough given the scale of the crisis.
Bernanke said, 'believe me, the recovery is on track.'

points.point: Draghi declared the euro is irreversible
points.quote: we think the euro is irreversible
paraphrases: Draghi declared that the euro is irreversible.
He said the ECB views the single currency as irreversible.
Draghi asserted that the euro's future is irreversible.
decoys: Draghi acknowledged the euro's fate remained uncertain and reversible.
Draghi said the EU's expansion plans were irreversible.

points.point: Draghi said investors had retreated within their national boundaries amid financial fragmentation
points.quote: the financial fragmentation that has taken place in the euro area. Investors retreated within their national boundaries. The interbank market is not functioning.
paraphrases: Investors retreated within their national borders, Draghi said.
He noted investors had pulled back behind national lines amid the crisis.
Draghi said investors were retrenching within national boundaries.
decoys: Draghi said cross-border investment flows had increased sharply across the euro area.
Draghi said the interbank market was functioning normally across countries.

points.point: Draghi said the interbank market is not functioning across countries
points.quote: the financial fragmentation that has taken place in the euro area. Investors retreated within their national boundaries. The interbank market is not functioning.
paraphrases: He said the interbank market had stopped functioning across euro-area countries.
Draghi noted the interbank market was essentially frozen across borders.
The interbank market was not working across countries, Draghi said.
decoys: Draghi said the interbank market was functioning smoothly across the euro area.
Draghi said retail bank lending to households had slowed sharply.

points.point: The ECB's two big LTROs injected half a trillion euros of net liquidity into euro-area banks
points.quote: we took care of that with the two big LTROs where we injected half a trillion of net liquidity into the euro area banks
paraphrases: The ECB's two LTROs injected roughly €500 billion of net liquidity into euro-area banks.
Draghi noted the two big LTROs added half a trillion euros in liquidity to the banking system.
Around €500bn was injected via the ECB's twin LTRO operations, Draghi said.
decoys: The ECB's single LTRO injected about €100 billion into banks.
The Fed's QE program injected half a trillion dollars into markets.

points.point: Draghi argued sovereign bond risk premia tied to convertibility risk fall within the ECB's mandate
points.quote: to the extent that the size of these sovereign premia hampers the functioning of the monetary policy transmission channel, they come within our mandate.
paraphrases: Draghi said sovereign bond risk premia tied to convertibility fears fall within the ECB's mandate.
He argued that addressing convertibility-risk premia on government bonds is within the ECB's remit.
Draghi signaled the ECB could act on sovereign spreads driven by redenomination risk, calling it part of its mandate.
decoys: Draghi said sovereign debt levels were purely a fiscal matter, outside the ECB's remit.
Draghi noted convertibility concerns affect emerging-market central banks' reserve policies.

points.point: Draghi highlighted remarkable progress on deficit control across the euro area
points.quote: the progress in undertaking deficit control, structural reforms has been remarkable
paraphrases: Draghi highlighted remarkable progress on deficit control across the euro area.
He said progress on deficit control had been remarkable in recent months.
Draghi pointed to strong progress in deficit control among peripheral countries.
decoys: Draghi said deficit control efforts had stalled across the euro area.
Draghi praised progress on trade policy across the euro area.

points.point: Draghi highlighted remarkable progress on structural reforms across the euro area
points.quote: the progress in undertaking deficit control, structural reforms has been remarkable
paraphrases: Draghi highlighted remarkable progress on structural reforms across the euro area.
